items.title: Add structured milestone ledger write support to story_create
items.context: Extend story_create to accept optional structured milestones and write milestone-ledger.json as a candidate ledger after the story shell exists. Keep no-milestones behavior unchanged.

happy.desc: story_create with structured milestones writes milestone-ledger.json containing those rows in candidate state.

edge.desc: story_create without milestones does not create milestone-ledger.json.

adversarial.desc: story_create rejects malformed milestone rows before persisting a partial ledger.

items.title: Pass structured planner milestones through planner_create_story
items.context: If a reviewed planner draft carries structured milestone rows, planner_create_story should pass them into story_create so the same write boundary is used.

happy.desc: planner_create_story with draft milestones creates the story and a candidate milestone ledger through story_create.

edge.desc: planner_create_story without draft milestones preserves existing behavior and creates no ledger.

adversarial.desc: planner_create_story does not infer ledger rows from draft prose or checklist titles.

items.title: Support plan_skeleton --write structured milestone rows without prose inference
items.context: If plan_skeleton --write receives explicit milestone rows, write them through the same candidate ledger path. Read-only plan_skeleton remains read-only.

happy.desc: plan_skeleton --write with structured milestones writes a candidate milestone ledger.

edge.desc: plan_skeleton without --write never writes a milestone ledger even when milestone rows are supplied.

adversarial.desc: plan_skeleton --write with no structured milestones does not synthesize rows from story prose or checklist text.

items.title: Run targeted milestone ledger regression coverage
items.context: Build and run the focused milestone status/proofstory tests that cover the new planning write path and existing read-only boundary.

happy.desc: npm build succeeds after the structured milestone write changes.

edge.desc: ProofStory intent hardening smoke still passes, preserving existing ledger confirmation and gate behavior.

adversarial.desc: No test or implementation path creates milestone-ledger.json from prose-only input.
